name: tunnelto.me Free Hosted Tunnels
free_limit: The Free account is ongoing, but each hosted tunnel resource expires after one hour; unlimited one-hour tunnels on one custom domain, one tunnelto.me subdomain, 500 MB bandwidth/month, 100 requests/minute and 5 Mbps.
watch_out: Classified as an expiring hosted resource, not a persistent ongoing free tunnel: every Free tunnel terminates after one hour and must be recreated, so this belongs in Time-limited / expiring offers, not the primary ongoing directory. Persistent tunnels and built-in bearer/password authentication require paid Hobbyist; domain registration may cost extra. Pre-26-Aug-2026 accounts may retain 1 GB/month; commercial-use permission is not explicit.
